update.title: Let agents create evidence during Work Reports
update.summary: Extended Work Report review so agents can create missing evidence, register it through artifact events, and return it to the same selection flow.

blocks.body:
## Create evidence when review finds a gap

Verification questions identify tools that can capture a screenshot, create a diagram, or register another file. An agent can act on missing evidence without leaving the report flow or carrying an opaque artifact ID between tools.

blocks.code:
flowchart LR
  Review[Review report evidence] --> Gap{Useful candidate available?}
  Gap -->|Yes| Candidates[Candidate artifacts]
  Gap -->|No| Create[Create screenshot, diagram, or data]
  Create --> Event[Publish artifact event]
  Event --> Candidates
  Candidates --> Decide[Review and select]
  Decide --> Attach[Attach to report]
blocks.description: Review can create missing material, return it through artifact discovery, and preserve the final selection boundary. Creating missing evidence feeds the same candidate review instead of bypassing it.

blocks.body:
## Feed new material back into discovery

Screenshot capture publishes an artifact event, while a generic registration tool accepts files created elsewhere. Both routes place the result in the active session’s candidates, where it follows the same review and attachment step as existing evidence.

## Keep creation and reporting decoupled

Artifact publication is best-effort during capture, so reporting does not control whether the source operation succeeds. Review remains the boundary that determines what becomes part of the report.
